We are looking for a software test engineer in the Infrastructure Solutions Software team. This is a hands-on technical role focused on system-level validation and quality for our infrastructure platforms. You will develop test automation, investigate complex system issues and contribute to high-quality delivery across pre-silicon and silicon environments. Come and make an impact at scale! Responsibilities: You will: Develop and implement system-level validation across pre-silicon and silicon environments; Develop test automation and infrastructure using appropriate tools, frameworks and programming languages; Contribute to CI, regression and test infrastructure design and improvements; Investigate and debug complex software, firmware and system-level issues; Collaborate across software, firmware and hardware teams to resolve defects and support product readiness. Required Skills and Experience: Strong experience in software testing and system-level validation for SoC, firmware, platform software or embedded systems; Proficiency in Python and experience with C and/or C++; Experience with Linux, system software, firmware or device drivers; Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including experience with software debugging tools; Experience with CI, regression testing, test coverage and defect management. “Nice To Have” Skills and Experience: Proficient working with Git; Curious about open-source development practices; Knowledgeable in computer architecture and microarchitecture concepts - ideally for the Arm architecture and its ecosystem; Familiarity with the Linux kernel, Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), UEFI EDK II, OpenBMC or Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM).
